title: Client Re-engagement QBR: Escalation & Mitigation Canvas
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a lightweight QBR-focused canvas for identifying at-risk renewals, escalating to the right execs, and running short mitigation sprints (48–14 day timelines depending on severity). Intended as a living working doc used during QBR prep and post-QBR action sprints.

Intended audience:
- CSMs preparing QBRs for accounts with declining health signals
- AEs for commercial escalation and contract negotiations
- CS leadership for triage and resource allocation
- RevOps for tracking interventions and outcomes

When to use this canvas:
- Account health score drops >= 20% over 30 days
- Usage runway indicates sub-50% of committed usage for next 60 days
- Critical feature regressions or unresolved support P1s for >72 hours
- Exec asks for a renewal confidence update at QBR

One-line executive summary template (use in QBR deck):
"At-risk: X% renewal confidence (was Y% last quarter). Primary drivers: [usage drop / ROI gap / technical blockers]. Recommended immediate action: [canary fix / pricing concession / exec check-in by DATE]."

Signal checklist (binary signals; tick and date):
- Product usage: falling-active-connections (yes/no, date)
- Key feature adoption: top-3 feature usage < 40% of cohort median (yes/no, date)
- Support velocity: open-P1s > 72h (yes/no, date)
- NPS/CSAT trend: last survey delta <= -15 points (yes/no, date)
- Renewal posture: no-renewal-conversation scheduled within 30 days (yes/no, date)
- Financial: pricing/commit mismatch flagged by AE (yes/no, date)
- Competitive/procurement signals: procurement delay / RFP issued (yes/no, date)

Quick scoring rubric (0–5 per dimension, total 0–25):
- Usage impact (0 none — 5 near-zero usage)
- Business impact (0 low ROI — 5 strategic/critical)
- Support risk (0 none — 5 unresolved P1s impacting production)
- Exec engagement (0 highly engaged — 5 no exec contact)
- Procurement/financial (0 committed — 5 RFP/competitive switch)
Interpretation: 0–7 green, 8–14 yellow, 15+ red.

Escalation thresholds & owners:
- Yellow (8–14): CSM + AE sync within 3 business days; RevOps support for usage deep-dive; schedule a 30-min internal triage. Owner: CSM.
- Red (15+): Immediate escalations: CSM -> CS Lead -> Head of Sales (or named exec). 24–48h war room; assign primary owner and secondary cover. Owner: CS Lead.

Escalation channel & artifacts to open (must be created within 4 hours of classification):
- Create Jira ticket: prefix CS-ESCALATE-<account>-<YYYYMMDD> (link in doc)
- Slack channel: #cs-escalate-<account-short> (invite: AE, CS Lead, Solutions Eng, RevOps, Legal if finance concessions likely)
- Shared doc: this canvas saved in Drive + summary slide for execs

Play library (ordered by speed & impact) — fill checklist when executed:
1) "Usage Jumpstart" sprint (quick wins, 7–14 days)
   - Tactics: targeted onboarding workshops for top 5 users; 1:1 power-user outreach; run templated activation campaigns; enable helpful defaults/shortcuts to reduce time-to-value.
   - Owners: CSM + Solutions Eng.
   - Success metric: +25% weekly DAU in 14 days or re-baseline.
   - Suggested outreach email script: "Quick check — 30-min to unblock X?" (include scheduler link).

2) "Technical Rescue" (if P1s or integrations failing, 48–72h SLA)
   - Tactics: triage call with SRE/SE, hotfix prioritization, rollback plan, staggered canary.
   - Owners: SRE + SE + CSM.
   - Success metric: P1 closed <72h; stability back to baseline.
   - Note: Inform legal/contract team if incident materially breaches SLA.

3) "Value Reframe & ROI" (2–4 weeks)
   - Tactics: build short ROI memo showing realized / projected savings; present to exec sponsor; align on joint success criteria for next 90 days.
   - Owners: AE + CSM + Customer Exec Sponsor.
   - Success metric: Exec re-commit or formal expansion plan initiated.

4) "Commercial Bridge" (pricing concessions / credits — requires approvals)
   - Tactics: short-term credits for performance issues, temporary discount for increased usage commitments, pilot pricing reset.
   - Approval flow: AE -> RevOps -> CS Lead -> Head of Sales. Document concession in Jira and send formal amendment via Legal.

5) "Executive Intervention" (final escalation)
   - Tactics: CEO/GM/Head-of-Sales meeting, public roadmap commitment, or guarantee of delivery timelines.
   - Use only when other plays fail or account is strategic.

Play execution checklist (to tick off during run):
- [ ] Kickoff meeting with stakeholders inside 48h
- [ ] War room channel and Jira created
- [ ] Customer comms schedule agreed (who, what, when)
- [ ] Success metrics defined & owner assigned
- [ ] Weekly status updates drafted for execs

QBR slide skeleton (one slide per bullet recommended):
- Slide 1: Exec summary (one-liner + recommended action)
- Slide 2: Health snapshot (score + key signals)
- Slide 3: Usage & adoption trends (graphs, top 3 drivers)
- Slide 4: Incident/support summary (open/closed P1s)
- Slide 5: Commercial posture (contract dates, ARR at risk, payment cadence)
- Slide 6: Recommended plays & timeline (who does what, by when)
- Slide 7: Ask for execs (decision points: pricing, leadership involvement, resource allocation)

Decision authority matrix (who can approve what):
- CSM: run playbook, schedule enablement, SE triage (no commercial concessions)
- AE: negotiate minor credits (<10% ARR or one-month credit) with RevOps approval
- RevOps: approve credits up to 20% for up to 3 months with CS Lead sign-off
- CS Lead / Head of Sales: >20% credits or contract amendments requiring Legal
- Legal: final sign-off on contractual changes

Timeline guidelines (default cadence):
- Triage call within 48h of red classification
- Daily war-room sync until signal moves to yellow
- 7-day sprint review for Usage Jumpstart
- 14-day technical SLA window for P1 fixes
- 30-day executive review (if unresolved at that point)

Example scenarios (short):
1) High-velocity churn (mid-market SaaS customer): usage dropping 40% over 30 days after a failed integration. Score=17. Action: "Technical Rescue" + Usage Jumpstart + AE schedules exec check. Outcome goal: P1 closed <72h, usage +30% in 14 days, renewal confidence >= 60% by next QBR.
2) Strategic enterprise stalling on procurement: score=16 driven by RFP and legal procurement delays. Action: AE + CS Lead escalate to Head of Sales for exec-to-exec outreach; offer pilot amendment for procurement window. Outcome goal: procurement lodged, decision within 30 days.
3) Low-usage but high-value account: usage low but business impact high (score=15). Action: Value Reframe & ROI + executive briefing. Outcome goal: renew at full or expanded ARR.

Notes-to-self and known gaps (working doc):
- Need SQL snippets for the "feature adoption" metric (ask RevOps for canonical queries).
- Add canned email and call scripts for AE/CSM (Priya to draft).
- Confirm SLA matrix with SRE for P1 timelines in private deployments (Rosa).
- Map to retention analytics dashboards (Confluence: CONFLUENCE-REENGAGE-001).

Tracking & retro:
- Add a single row per intervention to the master tracker (sheet): account, score, plays run, start/end dates, result, revenue delta.
- Retro weeks: 30/60/90 day check-ins to capture what changed; update playbook.

Appendix A — suggested metrics & queries (RevOps):
- Weekly DAU/MAU for account (trend)
- Top-10 users by feature X usage last 30 days
- Support tl;dr: open tickets by severity + age
- Contract metrics: upcoming renewal date, ARR, payment term, true-up history

Appendix B — contacts & channels
- Slack: #cs-plays-recovery, #cs-ops, #legal-liaison
- War room invite list template: CSM, AE, SE, RevOps, CS Lead, Legal (if needed)

Next steps (action items):
- [Maya] finalize canned outreach templates and add to Drive (due: 2025-09-10)
- [Priya] draft SQL for feature-adoption metric (due: 2025-09-05)
- [Diego] create master tracker sheet and automate sheet->Jira link (due: 2025-09-12)
- [Rosa] confirm P1 SLA for private deployments with SRE (due: 2025-09-08)

Version notes: draft v0.3 — intended for CS leadership review and to be used as a live template in next QBR prep cycle.
